thread.title: A 3-day rout in technology stocks has the Nasdaq set to close at its lowest level in three weeks - MarketWatch

author: Mark DeCambre
title: A 3-day rout in technology stocks has the Nasdaq set to close at its lowest level in three weeks - MarketWatch
text:
The Nasdaq Composite Index midday Monday was on track to mark its third straight drop, with a decline putting the benchmark at its lowest finish since early July. The technology-leaning Nasdaq COMP, -1.62% was down 1.6% at 7,614, most recently, which would place the index, which has rung up 25 records in 2018, back to around its lowest level since July 5, when it closed at 7,586.43, according to FactSet data. A downturn in tech and internet-related shares, notably a sharp decline in Facebook Inc.'s stock FB, -4.52% has eroded some of the enthusiasm for the so-called FAANG names that have helped to drive the Nasdaq and the broader market to fresh heights. Beyond Facebook, Apple Inc. AAPL, -0.91% Google-parent Alphabet GOOG, -1.87% ] GOOGL, -2.11% Netflix Inc. NFLX, -5.55% and Amazon.com Inc. AMZN, -2.35% Tech also was hurting the broader market, with the S&P 500 index SPX, -0.68% off by 0.6% and the Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, -0.48% 0.5% lower.
